sections.title: TOEIC 金色證書 90 天訓練｜Day 6
sections.markdown:
今天主題是 **不定詞 `to + V` vs. 動名詞 `V-ing`**。前 5 天已完成詞性、句型、時態與主被動；今天開始進入 Part 5 很常見的「動詞後面到底接 `to V` 還是 `V-ing`」題型。

目前沒有收到前幾天的小考實際成績，因此今天維持 **860+ 標準難度**。建議約 **90～110 分鐘**，小考目標為 **4 分鐘內完成 10 題、9/10 以上**。

---

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜to V vs. V-ing
sections.markdown:
先看：

> The company plans _____ more employees.

(A) hire  
(B) to hire  
(C) hiring  
(D) hired

`plan` 後面通常接：

> **plan to + V**

所以：

> plans **to hire**

答案 **B**。

但：

> The company considered _____ more employees.

`consider` 後面通常接：

> **consider + V-ing**

所以：

> considered **hiring**

這就是今天的核心。

---

sections.title: ③ TOEIC 必背：後面接 to V
sections.markdown:
金色證書至少先熟這些：

| 動詞 | 結構 |
|---|---|
| plan | plan to V |
| decide | decide to V |
| agree | agree to V |
| hope | hope to V |
| expect | expect to V |
| want | want to V |
| need | need to V |
| promise | promise to V |
| refuse | refuse to V |
| offer | offer to V |

例如：

> We **plan to open** another branch.

> She **agreed to attend** the meeting.

> The company **expects to increase** sales.

不要背：

`plan = 計畫`

要背：

> **plan to do something**

---

sections.title: ④ TOEIC 必背：後面接 V-ing
sections.markdown:
| 動詞 | 結構 |
|---|---|
| avoid | avoid V-ing |
| consider | consider V-ing |
| enjoy | enjoy V-ing |
| finish | finish V-ing |
| suggest | suggest V-ing |
| recommend | recommend V-ing |
| postpone | postpone V-ing |
| practice | practice V-ing |

例如：

> We should avoid **making** the same mistake.

> The company is considering **opening** another branch.

> The manager suggested **changing** the schedule.

---

sections.title: ⑤ 最大陷阱：to 不一定是不定詞
sections.markdown:
看：

> We look forward to _____ from you.

(A) hear  
(B) hearing  
(C) heard  
(D) be heard

很多人看到 `to` 就選原形動詞。

錯。

因為：

> **look forward to + noun / V-ing**

這裡的 `to` 是介系詞。

所以：

> look forward to **hearing** from you

答案：

**B**

這句是商業 Email 超高頻：

> We look forward to hearing from you.

---

另一個：

> Employees are accustomed to _____ remotely.

答案：

> working

因為：

> be accustomed to + V-ing

---

還有：

> She is responsible for _____ new employees.

答案：

> training

因為：

介系詞 `for` 後面如果接動詞，要：

> **V-ing**

---

sections.title: ⑥ Listening｜Part 2 高分訓練
sections.markdown:
今天加入「語意回答」，不要只匹配單字。

### Q1

> Who's going to interview the applicants?

(A) I think Ms. Wang volunteered.  
(B) At ten thirty.  
(C) About twelve candidates.

答案：

**A**

volunteer 在這裡：

**自願負責。**

---

### Q2

> When does the training program begin?

(A) The schedule hasn't been finalized.  
(B) In Conference Room C.  
(C) New employees.

答案：

**A**

仍然是：

When 不一定回答日期。

---

### Q3

> Why did Daniel turn down the job offer?

(A) He accepted another position.  
(B) In the personnel department.  
(C) About $60,000.

答案：

**A**

今天新增片語：

> **turn down an offer**

= 拒絕邀約／工作機會。

---

### Q4

> Should we hire another sales representative?

(A) Sales have been increasing lately.  
(B) She's a qualified candidate.  
(C) The interview lasted an hour.

答案：

**A**

這題需要推論：

銷售增加 → 工作量可能增加 → 可以考慮增聘。

---

### Q5

> Haven't you completed the training yet?

(A) I have one more session tomorrow.  
(B) In the conference room.  
(C) About twenty employees.

答案：

**A**

否定疑問句依然：

**不要先思考 Yes / No，先找語意合理答案。**

---

sections.title: ⑦ Reading｜Part 7
sections.markdown:
限時 **2 分 30 秒**。

> **To:** All New Employees  
> **From:** Human Resources  
> **Subject:** Employee Orientation
>
> All employees hired during August are required to attend an orientation session on September 14. The session will begin at 9:00 A.M. in Conference Room 4B and is expected to last approximately three hours.
>
> During the orientation, representatives from Human Resources will explain employee benefits, workplace policies, and professional development opportunities. Employees will also receive information about the company's retirement plan.
>
> Please complete the attached employee information form before attending the session and bring a copy with you.
>
> Employees who are unable to attend should contact their immediate supervisor no later than September 10 to arrange an alternative session.

### Q1

Who is required to attend the orientation?

(A) All company employees  
(B) Employees hired in August  
(C) Department supervisors  
(D) Job applicants

### Q2

What will most likely be discussed?

(A) Customer complaints  
(B) Advertising strategies  
(C) Employee benefits  
(D) Product development

### Q3

What should employees do before attending?

(A) Complete a form  
(B) Meet their supervisor  
(C) Apply for benefits  
(D) Choose a retirement plan

### Q4

What should an employee do if unable to attend?

(A) Resign from the position  
(B) Attend without registering  
(C) Contact a supervisor  
(D) Submit another application

### Q5

Approximately when will the orientation end?

(A) 10:00 A.M.  
(B) 11:00 A.M.  
(C) 12:00 P.M.  
(D) 1:00 P.M.

答案：

**1B / 2C / 3A / 4C / 5C**

Q5 是推論：

9:00 + 3 hours → **12:00**

Part 7 要逐漸習慣這種「文章不直接寫答案」的題目。

sections.title: ⑩ 答案與解析
sections.markdown:
仿真題：

**1 B / 2 C / 3 C / 4 C / 5 B / 6 C / 7 C / 8 C / 9 C / 10 C**

你今天至少要形成這些反射：

> plan → **to V**

> consider → **V-ing**

> agree → **to V**

> avoid → **V-ing**

> look forward to → **V-ing**

> suggest → **V-ing**

> expect → **to V**

> responsible for → **V-ing**

> decide → **to V**

> finish → **V-ing**

---

今日小考：

**1 C / 2 B / 3 C / 4 C / 5 B / 6 A / 7 A / 8 A / 9 A / 10 B**

Q5 是今天最重要的陷阱：

> look forward **to receiving**

這個 `to` 是介系詞，所以：

**V-ing**

Q10：

> Haven't you submitted your application?

回答：

> I still need to update my résumé.

意思是：

「履歷還需要更新。」

因此可以推論：

**還沒有提交。**

這就是 860+ Part 2 很重要的能力：

**聽懂語意，而不是尋找相同單字。**

---

sections.title: ⑪ Day 4～5 錯題複習
sections.markdown:
昨天的核心：

**時間 → 主動/被動 → 動詞形式**

例如：

> The equipment _____ yesterday.

yesterday → 過去。

equipment 接受 inspect → 被動。

所以：

> **was inspected**

今天加入第四步：

> **動詞後面需要什麼形式？**

例如：

> plans _____

直接想到：

> plans **to install**

而：

> considers _____

直接想到：

> considers **installing**

因此 Part 5 現在開始使用完整流程：

**① 找句子結構 → ② 看時間 → ③ 判斷主被動 → ④ 判斷動詞搭配 → ⑤ 最後確認意思。**

---

sections.title: ⑫ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
第一輪，把今天 30 個單字複習兩次，尤其記：

> conduct an interview  
> qualified candidate  
> meet the qualifications  
> apply for a position  
> employee benefits  
> receive a promotion  
> performance review  
> eligible for

第二輪，不看教材，把下面動詞分成兩組：

**plan / consider / avoid / decide / suggest / expect / agree / finish / hope / recommend**

正確分類：

**to V：**

plan / decide / expect / agree / hope

**V-ing：**

consider / avoid / suggest / finish / recommend

第三輪，特別背這兩個：

> **look forward to V-ing**

> **be responsible for V-ing**

最後重新完成今日 10 題小考，限制 **3 分 30 秒**。

目標：

**9～10 題正確。**

如果你這幾天實際作答都已經可以穩定 9/10，接下來不需要繼續停留在大量基礎單題，我會逐步增加 **Part 5 混合題與 Part 7 閱讀量**，讓訓練更接近真正的 860+。

**Day 6 核心反射：不要看到 `to` 就選原形動詞。先判斷這個 `to` 是不定詞還是介系詞。**

下一課 **Day 7** 是第一週總複習與週測：會把 **詞性、五大句型、時態、主被動、to V / V-ing、Part 2、Part 7** 混在一起，進行第一輪較完整的 TOEIC 能力檢查。

# TOEIC 金色證書 90 天訓練｜Day 6

今天主題是 **不定詞 `to + V` vs. 動名詞 `V-ing`**。前 5 天已完成詞性、句型、時態與主被動；今天開始進入 Part 5 很常見的「動詞後面到底接 `to V` 還是 `V-ing`」題型。

目前沒有收到前幾天的小考實際成績，因此今天維持 **860+ 標準難度**。建議約 **90～110 分鐘**，小考目標為 **4 分鐘內完成 10 題、9/10 以上**。

---

# ② 今日文法｜to V vs. V-ing

先看：

> The company plans _____ more employees.

(A) hire  
(B) to hire  
(C) hiring  
(D) hired

`plan` 後面通常接：

> **plan to + V**

所以：

> plans **to hire**

答案 **B**。

但：

> The company considered _____ more employees.

`consider` 後面通常接：

> **consider + V-ing**

所以：

> considered **hiring**

這就是今天的核心。

---

# ③ TOEIC 必背：後面接 to V

金色證書至少先熟這些：

| 動詞 | 結構 |
|---|---|
| plan | plan to V |
| decide | decide to V |
| agree | agree to V |
| hope | hope to V |
| expect | expect to V |
| want | want to V |
| need | need to V |
| promise | promise to V |
| refuse | refuse to V |
| offer | offer to V |

例如：

> We **plan to open** another branch.

> She **agreed to attend** the meeting.

> The company **expects to increase** sales.

不要背：

`plan = 計畫`

要背：

> **plan to do something**

---

# ④ TOEIC 必背：後面接 V-ing

| 動詞 | 結構 |
|---|---|
| avoid | avoid V-ing |
| consider | consider V-ing |
| enjoy | enjoy V-ing |
| finish | finish V-ing |
| suggest | suggest V-ing |
| recommend | recommend V-ing |
| postpone | postpone V-ing |
| practice | practice V-ing |

例如：

> We should avoid **making** the same mistake.

> The company is considering **opening** another branch.

> The manager suggested **changing** the schedule.

---

# ⑤ 最大陷阱：to 不一定是不定詞

看：

> We look forward to _____ from you.

(A) hear  
(B) hearing  
(C) heard  
(D) be heard

很多人看到 `to` 就選原形動詞。

錯。

因為：

> **look forward to + noun / V-ing**

這裡的 `to` 是介系詞。

所以：

> look forward to **hearing** from you

答案：

**B**

這句是商業 Email 超高頻：

> We look forward to hearing from you.

---

另一個：

> Employees are accustomed to _____ remotely.

答案：

> working

因為：

> be accustomed to + V-ing

---

還有：

> She is responsible for _____ new employees.

答案：

> training

因為：

介系詞 `for` 後面如果接動詞，要：

> **V-ing**

---

# ⑥ Listening｜Part 2 高分訓練

今天加入「語意回答」，不要只匹配單字。

### Q1

> Who's going to interview the applicants?

(A) I think Ms. Wang volunteered.  
(B) At ten thirty.  
(C) About twelve candidates.

答案：

**A**

volunteer 在這裡：

**自願負責。**

---

### Q2

> When does the training program begin?

(A) The schedule hasn't been finalized.  
(B) In Conference Room C.  
(C) New employees.

答案：

**A**

仍然是：

When 不一定回答日期。

---

### Q3

> Why did Daniel turn down the job offer?

(A) He accepted another position.  
(B) In the personnel department.  
(C) About $60,000.

答案：

**A**

今天新增片語：

> **turn down an offer**

= 拒絕邀約／工作機會。

---

### Q4

> Should we hire another sales representative?

(A) Sales have been increasing lately.  
(B) She's a qualified candidate.  
(C) The interview lasted an hour.

答案：

**A**

這題需要推論：

銷售增加 → 工作量可能增加 → 可以考慮增聘。

---

### Q5

> Haven't you completed the training yet?

(A) I have one more session tomorrow.  
(B) In the conference room.  
(C) About twenty employees.

答案：

**A**

否定疑問句依然：

**不要先思考 Yes / No，先找語意合理答案。**

# ⑦ Reading｜Part 7

限時 **2 分 30 秒**。

> **To:** All New Employees  
> **From:** Human Resources  
> **Subject:** Employee Orientation
>
> All employees hired during August are required to attend an orientation session on September 14. The session will begin at 9:00 A.M. in Conference Room 4B and is expected to last approximately three hours.
>

>

>
> Employees who are unable to attend should contact their immediate supervisor no later than September 10 to arrange an alternative session.

### Q1

Who is required to attend the orientation?

(A) All company employees  
(B) Employees hired in August

(D) Job applicants

### Q2

(A) Customer complaints  
(B) Advertising strategies  
(C) Employee benefits  
(D) Product development

### Q3

What should employees do before attending?

(A) Complete a form  
(B) Meet their supervisor  
(C) Apply for benefits

### Q4

What should an employee do if unable to attend?

(A) Resign from the position  
(B) Attend without registering  
(C) Contact a supervisor

Approximately when will the orientation end?

# ⑩ 答案與解析

仿真題：

**1 B / 2 C / 3 C / 4 C / 5 B / 6 C / 7 C / 8 C / 9 C / 10 C**

你今天至少要形成這些反射：

> plan → **to V**

> consider → **V-ing**

> agree → **to V**

> avoid → **V-ing**

> look forward to → **V-ing**

> suggest → **V-ing**

> expect → **to V**

> responsible for → **V-ing**

> decide → **to V**

> finish → **V-ing**

---

今日小考：

**1 C / 2 B / 3 C / 4 C / 5 B / 6 A / 7 A / 8 A / 9 A / 10 B**

Q5 是今天最重要的陷阱：

> look forward **to receiving**

這個 `to` 是介系詞，所以：

**V-ing**

Q10：

> Haven't you submitted your application?

回答：

> I still need to update my résumé.

意思是：

「履歷還需要更新。」

因此可以推論：

**還沒有提交。**

這就是 860+ Part 2 很重要的能力：

**聽懂語意，而不是尋找相同單字。**

# ⑪ Day 4～5 錯題複習

昨天的核心：

**時間 → 主動/被動 → 動詞形式**

例如：

> The equipment _____ yesterday.

yesterday → 過去。

equipment 接受 inspect → 被動。

所以：

> **was inspected**

今天加入第四步：

> **動詞後面需要什麼形式？**

例如：

> plans _____

直接想到：

> plans **to install**

而：

> considers _____

直接想到：

> considers **installing**

因此 Part 5 現在開始使用完整流程：

**① 找句子結構 → ② 看時間 → ③ 判斷主被動 → ④ 判斷動詞搭配 → ⑤ 最後確認意思。**

---

# ⑫ 今日作業

第一輪，把今天 30 個單字複習兩次，尤其記：

> conduct an interview  
> qualified candidate  
> meet the qualifications  
> apply for a position  
> employee benefits  
> receive a promotion  
> performance review  
> eligible for

第二輪，不看教材，把下面動詞分成兩組：

**plan / consider / avoid / decide / suggest / expect / agree / finish / hope / recommend**

正確分類：

**to V：**

plan / decide / expect / agree / hope

**V-ing：**

consider / avoid / suggest / finish / recommend

第三輪，特別背這兩個：

> **look forward to V-ing**

> **be responsible for V-ing**
